mapper.select: SELECT s.day_of_week AS dayOfWeek, s.effective_from AS effectiveFrom, s.is_open AS isOpen, s.open_time AS openTime, s.close_time AS closeTime, s.slot_minutes AS slotMinutes, s.break_minutes AS breakMinutes, s.default_capacity AS defaultCapacity FROM erp_bookstore_schedule s JOIN () v ON v.day_of_week = s.day_of_week AND v.effective_from = s.effective_from WHERE s.center_code = #{centerCode} ORDER BY s.day_of_week ASC

SELECT t.slot_template_id AS slotTemplateId, t.day_of_week AS dayOfWeek, t.seq AS seq, t.start_time AS startTime, t.end_time AS endTime, t.capacity AS capacity FROM erp_bookstore_schedule_slot t JOIN () v ON v.day_of_week = t.day_of_week AND v.effective_from = t.effective_from WHERE t.center_code = #{centerCode} ORDER BY t.day_of_week ASC, t.seq ASC

SELECT day_of_week AS dayOfWeek, effective_from AS effectiveFrom FROM erp_bookstore_schedule WHERE center_code = #{centerCode} AND effective_from > #{baseDate} ORDER BY day_of_week ASC, effective_from ASC

SELECT slot_template_id AS slotTemplateId, day_of_week AS dayOfWeek, seq AS seq, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, capacity AS capacity FROM erp_bookstore_schedule_slot WHERE center_code = #{centerCode} AND day_of_week = #{dayOfWeek} AND effective_from = #{effectiveFrom} ORDER BY seq ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_schedule_del (log_type, logged_by, center_code, day_of_week, effective_from, is_open, open_time, close_time, slot_minutes, break_minutes, default_capacity, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by) SELECT #{logType}, #{loggedBy}, center_code, day_of_week, effective_from, is_open, open_time, close_time, slot_minutes, break_minutes, default_capacity, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by FROM erp_bookstore_schedule WHERE center_code = #{centerCode} AND day_of_week = #{dayOfWeek} AND effective_from = #{effectiveFrom}

INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_schedule (center_code, day_of_week, effective_from, is_open, open_time, close_time, slot_minutes, break_minutes, default_capacity, created_by) VALUES ( #{centerCode}, #{day.dayOfWeek}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{day.isOpen},
#{day.openTime,jdbcType=TIME,typeHandler=com.hohoedu.book_clinic._core.config.typehandler.LocalTimeTypeHandler}, #{day.closeTime,jdbcType=TIME,typeHandler=com.hohoedu.book_clinic._core.config.typehandler.LocalTimeTypeHandler}, #{day.slotMinutes}, #{day.breakMinutes}, #{day.defaultCapacity}, #{userId} )

INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_schedule_slot (center_code, day_of_week, effective_from, seq, start_time, end_time, capacity) VALUES
(#{centerCode}, #{dayOfWeek}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{i} + 1, #{s.startTime,typeHandler=com.hohoedu.book_clinic._core.config.typehandler.LocalTimeTypeHandler}, #{s.endTime,typeHandler=com.hohoedu.book_clinic._core.config.typehandler.LocalTimeTypeHandler}, #{s.capacity})
